All n>=6 resolvent-degree lower bounds require embeddings and essential-rank definitions plus geometric obstruction. Checking finitely many ranks is not full scope.
All eccentricities in a punctured interval require validated dynamical estimates uniform in epsilon. Tiny explicit constants do not supply a small exact orbit certificate or diffusion proof.

For each k and sufficiently large n exact density inequality needs asymptotic extremal argument or scalable violating construction. No full-family mechanism identified; no brute force invested.

Complete reflection-arrangement classification and all symbolic powers for d=2 involve exceptional groups and infinite monomial family. A few ideal calculations are only instances; source body uninspected.

All nonfaithful cyclic actions require primitive rational central idempotents and integral nilpotent witnesses. Even C17 semidirect C8 requires action-specific Wedderburn data. No full-scope or exact obstruction justified.

All finite inverse temperatures and n>=3 exponential decay requires uniform mass-gap mechanism; high-temperature expansion alone omits low-temperature regime.
All k and arbitrary metrics/request sequences requires universal online invariant. Circle 3-server special case cannot bridge the full conjecture.

Exact limiting h(r)/r^2 needs matching asymptotic extremal bases and upper bound for every order. No small finite certificate can determine the limit.

Greedy bicriteria question leaves precise repeated-greedy algorithm and p-system violation interpretation source dependent. AI-claim survey is not primary proof clearance; no full guarantee/counterexample developed.
Every multiple of four requires unrestricted Hadamard construction; Sylvester orders and isolated examples leave full scope untouched.

Williamson universal existence has a known-counterexample warning, but no original nonexistence proof body inspected here. Do not generate or credit another classical finite instance; primary publication required.
Arbitrary nonunital associative rings and sums of nil left ideals require ring-theoretic global mechanism. Elementwise nilpotence has no uniform exponent; finite rings do not resolve it.
Exact optimum area plus an attaining universal cover needs matching lower bound over all compact convex covers. Improving a geometric upper bound is not the requested result.
Exact plane chromatic number requires matching infinite-plane coloring and obstruction. A finite unit-distance graph only supplies a lower bound unless it closes the gap.

General locally compact group actions on all manifold dimensions require topological exclusion beyond special dimensions/regularities. Do not exploit omitted conventional manifold qualifications as a discovery.
Kadison-Singer has a classical published resolution warning; no MSS proof body read here. Formalizing/reconstructing that theorem is ineligible, registry and body clearance not claimed.

Fixed-degree limiting distribution requires concentration and total-mass tightness, not just expected degree asymptotics. Likely successor enumeration results must be body-mapped before a new target exists.
Explicitly excludes interval Julia sets, so source counterexample cannot refute modified scope. Need semigroup-wide Julia rigidity, not method similarity to the original counterexample.
Literal infinitude is stated equivalent to twin primes. Weight reparameterization supplies no tractable full-scope mechanism or independent discovery.

Group von Neumann algebra embedding requires precise hyperlinear-group connection; general Connes-embedding refutation cannot simply be asserted to settle this restricted group scope without a bridge. Current registry unavailable.

All non-even p and three signed terms need explicit frequency/sign family and analytic norm gap over intervals. Known majorant counterexamples with more terms do not settle the three-term requirement; precise p domain and successors uninspected.

Average bounded-cell diameter across all simple arrangements needs global combinatorial charging or scalable violation. Individual high-diameter cells do not refute the average conjecture; no full route identified.
